text:
Olivia (People Ops): Heads-up — quick ops question about a mid-cycle level change that just got signed off. Effective 2026-04-01. Is salary change prorated or retroactive on our payroll process?
Devon (Backend Manager): Thanks — approval went through on 2026-03-29. The IC expects comms this week. Need to know whether they see the new pay in their next paycheck or a separate retro.
Maria (Payroll): Short answer: we can do either, but standard practice is retroactive to the effective date and a single backpay adjustment if approval missed the payroll cutoff. Cutoff for the 03/31 cycle was 2026-03-31 23:59 PT.
Olivia (People Ops): Ah — cutoff passed. Can you confirm what I need to send to trigger the retro?
Maria (Payroll): Please send a CSV file with these columns: employee_id, employee_name, old_annual, new_annual, eff_date, comp_approver_code, manager_note. Example row: 
```
12345,Devon Lee,120000,135000,2026-04-01,CC-PRM-2026-04,"Promotion to L4, approved 2026-03-29"
```
Also include the Workday change task ID and a link to the approval email.
Devon (Backend Manager): Got it. Any required GL/charge codes?
Maria (Payroll): Use GL code 5-700-01 for base salary adjustments. For backpay, payroll will generate a separate line with tax withholding applied in the retro period. If comp_approver_code is missing the case will stall.
Olivia (People Ops): If we wanted to instead delay and put the increase starting next cycle (no retro), is that allowed? Pros/cons?
Maria (Payroll): Allowed, but must be explicit in the employee communication and approved by comp. Pro: simpler payroll run. Con: employee may be unhappy if they expected pay effective 4/1. We typically only do that when the manager requests it and documents the reason.
Devon (Backend Manager): We'll stick with retro. One more: does target bonus get pro-rated for the year when promotion mid-cycle?
Maria (Payroll): Target bonus is pro-rated based on eff_date for ongoing target calculations. Sign-on or special one-time payments are handled as separate items — label them as `SIGNON` or `ONE-TIME` in the CSV so we map tax codes correctly.
Payroll-bot: Reminder — next scheduled payroll run: 2026-04-02 08:00 UTC. Retro adjustments will be applied in the 2026-04-15 payroll posting window. :information_source:
Olivia (People Ops): Thanks all — I'll assemble the CSV and post here with the Workday task ID and comp approver code. CC-ing @Maria when done. :thumbsup:
Devon (Backend Manager): Thanks, Olivia. I'll prepare manager_note text.
Maria (Payroll): Perfect. Once we receive the CSV I'll confirm the GL mapping and give an ETA for the backpay posting.
Olivia (People Ops): Posting the CSV shortly.
